limitations: The Phase 4A checkpoint-generation Git SHA is unavailable because it predates the first commit; checkpoint hashes and effective config are preserved.
2020-2022 was previously used validation and also calibrates randomized duration pairs.
2023-2025 is exploratory and contaminated by Alpha feature selection.
Per-stock averages are not a multi-stock portfolio; no allocation rule is evaluated.
Randomized controls match completed-trade validation wait/hold pairs, not PPO's no-trade episode behavior.
